<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/business/resetpassword/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Two modes. Signed-in change: send `email` + `oldpassword` + `newpassword` (the current password is verified). Forgotten password: send `email` + `otp` + `newpassword`, where `otp` is the code emailed by `POST /business/forgotpassword/`. An invalid or expired code returns `09` with `errorcode` `INVALID_RESET_CODE`.
